dct_description_sm: "Loyal part" of the coast is distinguished by a heavy line and the "rebel part" by a thin line.

"This sketch was prepared to show at a glance the difference in extent of the coasts of the U. States occupied by the loyal men and rebels; its circulation it is believed will have the effect of counteracting the exertions of traitors at home as well as those abroad. Persons having correspondents in Europe would do well to send copies of this sketch to them for circulation. The figures ... show the depth of water. Geo. W. Blunt."
Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
